title: Finishing what I start
group: LDS-FOCUS — Focus and Getting Things Done
examples: How do I finish my work?
I start things but never finish
How do I keep going when I get bored?

explain.say: Starting a drawing is fun. But finishing it? That can be harder. Imagine a race with a finish line. Look at the board. It shows the path, from start to done.

explain.say: You have started, great. See keep going light up? Now do the next small bit. Then the next. Little bits add up. If you feel bored, set a short timer. Can you think of a job you left half done?

explain.say: Nearly there! See the eye? Check it. Look over your work one time. Did you do every part? Is your name on it? A quick check makes it ready. What would you check?

explain.say: Done! Put it away and feel that warm, proud feeling. You crossed the finish line. Well done! Here is a challenge. Pick one thing you started this week, and finish it today.

faq.a: Do one small bit at a time. Set a short timer or plan a tiny reward for the end, like a stretch or a sticker.

faq.q: What if I get stuck in the middle?
faq.a: Stop and ask. You can say, Can you help me, please? or I do not understand this part. A grown-up you trust can help.

faq.q: Why is finishing a good feeling?
faq.a: When you finish, your brain feels proud. That good feeling makes it easier to start the next job.

faq.q: How do I check my work?
faq.a: Look once from the top. Did you do every part? Is your name on it? Then put it away.

faq.q: What if I want to start something new instead?
faq.a: Write the new idea on a sticky note, so you do not lose it. Then finish your first job before you start it.

facts: Big jobs are easier to finish when they are cut into small parts.
A short check at the end catches small mistakes before you hand work in.

quiz.say: You are stuck in the middle of a job. What helps?

quiz.why: Asking for help gets you unstuck, so you can finish.

wrong.1: Starting a new job leaves this one unfinished.
wrong.2: Your work is worth finishing. Ask for help instead.

quiz.say: What is the last step before done?
quiz.show: What is the last step before done?
quiz.why: A quick check makes sure every part is finished.

wrong.1: No need to start again. Just check it.
wrong.2: Your finished work deserves to be seen.
